name: Tabsona
description: Give each Chrome tab its own login session. Save, open and reuse a whole set of signed-in sites as a persona — built for developers testing their own apps across many roles and tenants.

positioning.audience: Developers testing their own apps across many roles and tenants
positioning.problem: Testing six roles means six browser profiles, six windows, or six browsers
positioning.differentiator: Sessions are saved and restorable, and the badge reports honestly when a site cannot be fully isolated

brand.note: Branding phase skipped by request; icons are generated from apps/extension/scripts/make-icons.mjs
